description: Create a new Alert State Timeline in OneUptime. Returns the created Alert State Timeline object with its ID. Use this to add new Alert State Timelines to your project. Note: projectId is inferred from your API key — you do not need to provide it.

alertId.description: Relation to Alert ID in which this resource belongs.

alertStateId.description: Alert State ID Relation. Which alert state does this alert change to?

endsAt.description: When did this status change end?

projectId.description: ID of your OneUptime Project in which this object belongs.

rootCause.description: What is the root cause of this status change?

startsAt.description: When did this status change? Correct this when the recorded time is wrong - every measurement derived from this timeline is recomputed from the corrected value.

name: create_alert_state_timeline
title: Create Alert State Timeline
